Thanks @pcbeingused333 for building the tests on real SDK clients over `httpx2.MockTransport`, so they check the request body that actually goes out.

I ran this branch (`648478d`) against Amazon Bedrock (us-east-1), where #16395 was reported. For the models Bedrock offers, your list is right, but Bedrock IDs carry a `us.`/`global.` + `anthropic.` prefix, so `self.model.startswith(...)` is false and the forced tool is still sent:

| Model ID (`AnthropicBedrock` client) | This branch | With the one-line change below |
|---|---|---|
| `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5` (sync and async) | ❌ 400 | ✅ `auto`, structured output returned |
| `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` | ❌ 400 | ✅ `auto` |
| `us.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1` | ❌ 400 | ✅ `auto` |
| `global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5` | ❌ 400 | ✅ `auto` |
| `us.anthropic.claude-{opus-5,sonnet-5,haiku-5-5,fable-5}` | ✅ forced `tool` | ✅ forced `tool` (unchanged) |

The 400 message is `tool_choice: type "tool" and "any" are not supported for this model.` A substring match covers both naming schemes:

```python
        if any(m in self.model for m in _MODELS_REJECTING_FORCED_TOOL_CHOICE):
```

Adding `"us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5"` and `"global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5"` to the first parametrize list in `test_tool_choice.py` (and `"us.anthropic.claude-opus-5"` to the second) pins it: 2 failed / 9 passed on this branch, 11 passed with the change.

For context, #16403, which is linked to #16395, edits the same two `tool_choice` lines with substring matching and the same list minus Mythos 5.1. If there is a reason to keep `startswith` that I'm missing, please ignore the suggestion.

<details><summary>Commands and output</summary>

`live.py` builds `AnthropicAdapter(client=AnthropicBedrock(aws_region="us-east-1"), model=m)` and calls `generate_object` (one `async_generate_object` call for Opus 5.5) with a two-label schema.

```text

sync  us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5     tool_choice=tool -> 400 tool_choice: type "tool" and "any" are not supported for this model.
sync  us.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1      tool_choice=tool -> 400 tool_choice: type "tool" and "any" are not supported for this model.
sync  global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5   tool_choice=tool -> 400 tool_choice: type "tool" and "any" are not supported for this model.
sync  us.anthropic.claude-opus-5         tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5       tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5      tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-fable-5        tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
async us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5       tool_choice=tool -> 400 tool_choice: type "tool" and "any" are not supported for this model.

# with the substring change
sync  us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5       tool_choice=auto -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5     tool_choice=auto -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1      tool_choice=auto -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5   tool_choice=auto -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-opus-5         tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5       tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5      tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
sync  us.anthropic.claude-fable-5        tool_choice=tool -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
async us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5       tool_choice=auto -> OK {'label': 'incorrect'}
```

anthropic 1.15.0, Python 3.13. Mythos 5.1 is not in the Bedrock us-east-1 model list, so that entry is untested here.
</details>

Thanks for running it on Bedrock. You're right: the `startswith` check misses the `us.`/`global.` + `anthropic.` prefixes. 6c1e68a switches to the substring match you suggested and adds the three Bedrock IDs to the tests (`us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` get `auto`; `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5` still forces the tool). Those rows fail with the old check (2 failed / 9 passed) and pass with the change. The anthropic adapter tests pass (35).

Heads-up for the maintainers: this overlaps with #16403, open since September, which applies the same fix (substring match on `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-fable-5-1` and `claude-sonnet-5-5`, with `tool_choice` set to `auto`) and already covers the Bedrock IDs and has been run against Bedrock. What this PR adds on top is the `claude-mythos-5-1` entry, plus tests that go through real SDK clients over `httpx2.MockTransport` instead of a mocked client.

I don't want to compete with it. If you would rather merge #16403, I'm happy to reduce this PR to the Mythos 5.1 entry and its test once #16403 is in, or to close this one in its favour, whichever you prefer.

This comment was prepared with Claude Code.

Thanks @pcbeingused333. #17366, which builds on this PR, fixed the same 400 error: Anthropic object generation now always sends `tool_choice: auto` and asks for the tool call in the system prompt, so it works on every model without a list of model names. #17476 adds native structured output on top of that. Closing as superseded.
